name: Ringer Hal

intro.text: St Peter Mancroft, on the market, rang the first true peal in history in 1715: over five thousand changes with no repeats. I'll ring the changes on you.

win: Stand! That's what we say when we stop.
after: Change ringing is maths you can hear. Every row is a different order of the bells, and you never ring the same row twice.
